_about: Strings of the Version and migration section.
version.title: Version and migration
version.about: The engine inside a project is updated from the kit by a whitelist (engine_manifest.txt). Project content is never touched.
version.engine_about: The .aurora/ folder is a copy of the engine on this computer. It does not travel through git: a clone of the project arrives without it. The panel completes it itself when you pick the project and changes nothing in the project files or in git. The rest of the update (AGENTS.md, templates, the folder schema, .gitignore rules) is the update preview below.
version.engine_legacy_about: The engine is still in the old .opencode/ folder: Update preview → Apply moves it to .aurora/.
version.engine_done: The engine is prepared on this computer: {created} created, {refreshed} replaced.
version.engine_not_ignored: The .aurora/ folder is not covered by .gitignore — Apply below adds the rule.
version.warn: An update rewrites only the files from engine_manifest.txt: the skill, the scripts, the folder schema. Your templates and prompts are not touched — the new version is placed next to them as .new. After applying it, make a commit: that way it is visible what exactly the engine changed.
version.engine_only: Show what would be completed in .aurora/ on this computer (no writing)
version.structure_only: Create the missing schema folders without touching the engine
version.structure: Show folders outside the schema: their contents move to Workspaces/
